scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @cove/contracts && npm run build -w @cove/client-core && npm run build -w @cove/media-core && npm run build -w @cove/diagnostics
scripts.build:client: npm run build:packages && npm run build:electron -w cove-client -- --publish never
scripts.build:server: npm run build:packages && npm run build:electron -w cove-server -- --publish never
scripts.check: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck -w cove-client && npm run build -w cove-server && npm --prefix apps/mobile run typecheck && node --test tests/architecture.test.cjs tests/dev-startup.test.cjs
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm test -w @cove/client-core && npm test -w cove-server && npm test -w cove-client && npm --prefix apps/mobile test -- --runInBand
